titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Blessing of the Obedient King (ch. 41)
part: ch. 41 — The Blessing of the Obedient King
about: The prophet-king's counsel turns to blessing: a long run of 'Blessed shall you be...' modeled on Deuteronomy 28, each blessing answered 'Amen' by the assembly, then the promise of the nations' homage, and a closing charge to judge the poor and rich alike without partiality.

sentences.t: ፵፩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ነገሥት ።
sentences.l: 41. Concerning blessing-of kings
sentences.i: Chapter 41: Concerning the Blessing of Kings
sentences.n: Chapter heading. Read በእንተ ('concerning') and then the construct chain በረከተ ነገሥት, 'blessing-of kings': the first noun takes the construct ending -ä and the second stands in the genitive with nothing between them. The chapter is a long benediction for the obedient king, built closely on the blessings of Deuteronomy 28:1-14, then turning into counsel on justice.

sentences.t: ወስማዕሂ ፡ ዘይረክበከ ፡ ቡራኬ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-hear-also what-will-find-you blessing if you-have-done his-will to-God.
sentences.i: And hear this also: the blessing that will come upon you if you do the will of God.
sentences.n: ስማዕ is a 2ms imperative ('hear!') with proclitic ወ- 'and' in front and the enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed' behind it. ዘይረክበከ is ዘ- 'that which' + the 3ms imperfect ይረክብ + -ከ 'you': 'what will find you'. ለእመ 'if' is the ordinary conditional here. Watch the construction ፈቃዶ ለእግዚኣብሔር, literally 'his will, to God': a pronoun suffix (-o) announces the possessor, which then follows with ለ-. Geʿez does this constantly, and it comes back below with ተዐገሳ ለመዐት and others.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውንበኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊከ ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በሀገር ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በሐቅል ፤ ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በቤትከ ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በአፍአከ ፤ ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ከርሥከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed you-will-be in-all your-ways; blessed you-will-be in-city, blessed you-will-be in-field; blessed you-will-be in-your-house, blessed you-will-be in-your-outside; blessed it-will-be fruit-of your-womb.
sentences.i: Blessed will you be in all your ways. Blessed will you be in the city and blessed in the field; blessed in your house and blessed outside it; blessed will be the fruit of your womb.
sentences.n: Echoes Deuteronomy 28:3-4 (city and field, fruit of the womb). The run of ቡሩከ ትከውን, 'blessed you will be', is the pattern of the whole chapter. ቡሩከ ends in the accusative -ä because it is the predicate of the verb 'to be' (ኮነ); ትከውን is the 2ms imperfect, and ይከውን in the last clause is 3ms, 'it will be', with ፍሬ ከርሥከ 'fruit-of your-womb' (construct chain, then -ከ 'your') as its subject. Note the run-together ትከውንበኵሉ: the packet prints it as one word for ትከውን በኵሉ, and the same happens with ይከውንፍሬ, ኵሉዘወደይከ, ለብዙኃንአሕዛብ and ከመይኩኑ below; those are the printed edition's spacing, not new words. ፍናዊከ is the plural of ፍኖት 'way' + -ከ. በአፍአከ, literally 'in your outside', is 'abroad, outside the house'.

sentences.t: ይቤሉ ፡ ጉቡኣን ፡ አሜን ።
sentences.l: Said the-assembled: Amen.
sentences.i: The assembled people said, 'Amen.'
sentences.n: ይቤሉ is the 3mp perfect of ብህለ 'say' (ብህለ has this suppletive perfect, ይቤ, 'said'; its imperfect is ይብል). ጉቡኣን is the plural of ጉቡእ, 'gathered, assembled' (root ጐብአ/g-b-ʾ (?)), here the congregation. The scene is liturgical: the king is blessed in the presence of an assembly, and each blessing draws its response, አሜን.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ምድርከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed it-will-be fruit-of your-land.
sentences.i: Blessed will be the fruit of your land.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:4 again. Same frame as before: ቡሩከ ይከውን + subject. ፍሬ ምድርከ is a construct chain, 'fruit-of your-land'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: The response, repeated after each blessing; I note it only where something else is new.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ ማያቲከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed it-will-be springs-of your-waters.
sentences.i: Blessed will be the springs of your waters.
sentences.n: አንቅዕተ is the construct of አንቅዕት 'spring', here in the accusative form (-ä) although it is the logical subject. The scribe seems to treat ይከውን as impersonal ('it will be blessed: the springs...'), which also explains the endings in the next few lines (ዐጸደ and መራዕየ). ማያቲከ is ማያት, the plural of ማይ 'water', + -ከ 'your'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውንፍሬ ፡ አትክልቲከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed it-will-be fruit-of your-plantings.
sentences.i: Blessed will be the fruit of your plantings.
sentences.n: The packet prints ይከውንፍሬ as one word; it is ይከውን ፍሬ. አትክልቲከ is አትክልት, a collective for what is planted (from ተከለ 'plant'; 'produce of the garden' also fits (?)), + -ከ.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ላህምከ ፡ ወመራዕየ ፡ አባግዒከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed it-will-be pen-of your-cattle and-pastures-of your-sheep.
sentences.i: Blessed will be the pen of your cattle and the pastures of your sheep.
sentences.n: Both nouns stand in construct before their owners: ዐጸደ ላህምከ 'enclosure-of your-cattle' (ላህም is a collective 'cattle, oxen'), ወመራዕየ አባግዒከ 'and-pastures-of your-sheep' (አባግዕ is the plural of በግዕ 'sheep'). Compare Deuteronomy 28:4, 'the increase of your cattle, the flocks of your sheep'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ መዛግብቲከ ፡ ወተረፋቲከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed it-will-be your-storehouses and-your-surpluses.
sentences.i: Blessed will be your storehouses and your reserves.
sentences.n: መዛግብት is the plural of መዝገብ 'treasury, storehouse'; ተረፋት is from ተረፈ 'be left over', so 'what is left over, surplus, reserves' (?). Both take -ከ 'your'. The scribe may have Deuteronomy 28:5 in view ('your basket and your kneading-trough'), but he does not say so.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በበአትከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed you-will-be in-your-entering.
sentences.i: Blessed will you be in your coming in.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:6, 'in your coming in and in your going out'. በአት is the verbal noun of ቦአ 'enter', in the pattern በ- + noun + -ከ: 'in-your-entering'. Note that the verb has switched back from ይከውን to ትከውን, 'you will be'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በፀአትከ ።
sentences.l: Blessed you-will-be in-your-going-out.
sentences.i: Blessed will you be in your going out.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:6 completed. ፀአት is 'going out, departure', the counterpart of በአት.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወያገብኦሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለፀርከ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይትቃወሙከ ፡ ይትቀጥቀጡ ፡ በታሕተ ፡ እገሪከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-will-hand-over-them God to-your-enemy, to-those who oppose-you, to-be-crushed beneath your-feet.
sentences.i: And God will deliver them up, your enemies, those who stand against you, to be crushed beneath your feet.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:7 (enemies who rise up against you are struck down before you). Verbs: ያገብኦሙ is አግብአ (causative of ገብአ 'return') with ወ- and -ሙ 'them', hence 'deliver, give back them' (?); ይትቃወሙከ is ተቃወመ 'oppose, stand against' + -ከ; ይትቀጥቀጡ is a quadriliteral tä-stem, 'be crushed', in the jussive. The enemies are named twice, first ለፀርከ (ፀር is a collective 'enemy'), then ለእለ 'those who': the ለ- marks them as the object again, an apposition to the -ሙ already on the verb. በታሕተ is በ- + ታሕተ 'under, beneath', followed by a construct, እገሪከ 'your feet'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወይፌኑ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲከ ፡ በረከቶ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ኵሉዘወደይከ ፡ እዴከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-will-send God into your-houses his-blessing, and-into all-that you-put your-hand.
sentences.i: And God will send his blessing into your houses, and upon everything to which you put your hand.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:8 (the blessing on the barns and on all that you set your hand to). ወይፌኑ is ፈነወ 'send', 3ms imperfect with ወ-, the regular 3ms of a third-weak verb (the final -u is the stem's own -w, not a plural ending). Run-together: ኵሉዘወደይከ is ኵሉ ዘወደይከ, 'all that you put'. ዘወደይከ is ዘ- 'that which' + ወደየ 'put, set' in the 2ms perfect, and its object is እዴከ 'your hand'. አብያቲከ is the plural of ቤት 'house' + -ከ.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወያበዝኀከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሠናይት ፡ በውሉደ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ወበእክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወበተዋልዶ ፡ እንስሳከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-will-multiply-you God into good: with-children-of your-womb, and-with-produce-of your-land, and-with-offspring-of your-livestock.
sentences.i: And God will make you abound in good things: in the children of your womb, the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:11, 'the Lord will make you abound in goods, in the fruit of your womb, of your cattle and of your ground'. ያበዝኀከ is አብዝኀ, the causative of በዝኀ 'be many', + ወ- and -ከ: 'make you many'. The three nouns each take በ- 'with, in' and stand in construct: ውሉድ 'children', እክል 'grain, produce' (?), ተዋልዶ 'offspring, breeding', then the owner with -ከ. እንስሳ is 'animals, livestock'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወበምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐለ ፡ ለአበዊከ ፡ ይሁበከ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሰማይ ።
sentences.l: And-in-land which he-swore to-your-fathers he-will-give-you, like days-of heaven.
sentences.i: And in the land that he swore to your fathers that he would give you, as long as the days of heaven.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:11 ('the land which the Lord swore to your fathers to give you') joined with the phrase of Deuteronomy 11:21, 'as the days of heaven upon the earth'. መሐለ is the 3ms perfect of መሐለ 'swear'; ይሁበከ is the subjunctive of ወሀበ 'give', + -ከ 'to you', so 'swore to give you'. ወበምድር: ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + ምድር. ከመ before a noun is 'like', and መዋዕለ ሰማይ is a construct chain, 'days-of heaven', i.e. 'for as long as heaven lasts'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወይፈትሕ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መዝገበ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወይሁበከ ፡ ዝናመ ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ወይባርክ ፡ ለከ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ተግባርከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-will-open for-you God treasury-of blessing-of heavens, and-he-will-give-you rain blessed, and-he-will-bless for-you fruit-of your-work.
sentences.i: And God will open for you the treasury of the blessing of the heavens, and give you blessed rain, and bless for you the fruit of your labor.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:12, 'the Lord will open to you his good treasure, the heaven, to give the rain of your land in its season and to bless all the work of your hands'. Verbs: ይፈትሕ is ፈትሐ 'loosen, open' (the same verb that means 'judge' in 46 below); ይሁበከ, ይባርክ ለከ are 3ms imperfects. መዝገበ በረከተ ሰማያት is a double construct, 'treasury-of blessing-of the-heavens'. ዝናመ ቡሩከ is 'rain, blessed' (adjective agreeing in the accusative). ተግባር is 'work, deed' (from ገብረ).

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወትሌቅሕ ፡ አንተ ፡ ለብዙኃንአሕዛብ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ኢትትሌቃሕ ።
sentences.l: And-you-will-lend you to-many-nations, and-as-for-you you-will-not-borrow.
sentences.i: You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:12, 'you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow'. Run-together: ለብዙኃንአሕዛብ is ለብዙኃን አሕዛብ, 'to-many nations'. ትሌቅሕ is the 2ms imperfect of ለቅሐ 'lend' (the glossary's lemma; the long vowel of the imperfect is not explained) (?); ኢትትሌቃሕ is the tä-stem 'borrow' (?), negated. ወአንተሰ is ወ- + አንተ 'you' + the contrastive enclitic -ሰ, 'but as for you'.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወትኴንን ፡ አንተ ፡ ለብዙኃን ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወለከሰ ፡ ኢይኴንኑከ ።
sentences.l: And-you-will-rule you over-many nations, and-over-you-indeed they-will-not-rule.
sentences.i: You will rule over many nations, but over you they will not rule.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:13 and 15:6 (nations will not rule over you). ኰነነ 'rule, judge' takes ለ- 'over'; the verb ትኴንን is 2ms, and ኢይኴንኑከ is 3mp with -ከ 'you'. ወለከሰ is ወ- + ለከ 'over you' + -ሰ: the contrast is with the line before. Here ለብዙኃን አሕዛብ is written as two words.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወይሠይመከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእስ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዘነብ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ መትሕተ ።
sentences.l: And-he-will-set-you God into head and-not into tail, and-you-will-be above and-not below.
sentences.i: And God will set you at the head and not at the tail, and you will be above and not below.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:13, 'the Lord will make you the head and not the tail; you shall be above only, and not beneath'. ወአኮ 'and not' negates the word that follows it (not the verb), so the pairing ርእስ / ዘነብ 'head / tail' and መልዕልተ / መትሕተ 'above / below' reads cleanly. ይሠይመከ is ሠይመ 'appoint, set' with -ከ. ወትከውን could be 'and you will be' or '...she (it) will be'; the sense settles it as 2ms.

sentences.t: አሜን ።
sentences.l: Amen.
sentences.i: Amen.
sentences.n: Response.

sentences.t: ወታስተጋብእ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለእንስሳከ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-gather from all blessing-of earth for-your-livestock;
sentences.i: And you will gather from every blessing of the earth for your livestock;
sentences.n: Three sentences in this stretch (units 34-37, 38-40, 43-47) are long enough that they are cut at their semicolons (፤); the cuts follow Geʿez punctuation, and the English runs on across them. ታስተጋብእ is the 2ms imperfect of አስተጋብአ 'gather together'. እምነ ኵሉ is 'from all'; በረከተ ምድር is a construct chain, 'blessing-of earth'. The ለ- on ለእንስሳከ 'for your livestock' marks the beneficiary.

sentences.t: ወትነሥእ ፡ በርባረ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ለትዕይንትከ ፡ ወይሰግዱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለመንግሥትከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ክብርከ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-take plunder-of nations for-your-host, and-they-will-bow to-you to face-of earth, to-your-kingdom, because-of greatness-of your-glory;
sentences.i: You will take the spoil of the nations for your host, and they will bow down to you, face to the ground, before your kingdom, because of the greatness of your glory;
sentences.n: ትነሥእ is ነሥአ 'take'. በርባረ አሕዛብ is a construct, 'plunder-of nations' (በርባር 'spoil, plunder' (?), not certain of the lexical call). ትዕይንት is 'host, company' (?), perhaps an army drawn up for review. ሰገደ 'bow down': ይሰግዱ is 3mp, and ውስተ ገጸ ምድር, 'to the face of the earth', is the ordinary idiom for 'to the ground'. The sense of ለመንግሥትከ ('to / before / for your kingdom') is a little loose (?). በእንተ is 'because of, on account of'; ዕበየ ክብርከ is a double construct, 'greatness-of your-glory'.

sentences.t: ወይትሌዐል ፡ ክብርከ ፡ ከመ ፡ አርዝ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኮከበ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ ክብርከ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወበቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-it-will-be-exalted your-glory like cedar, and-like star-of morning light-of your-glory, before all peoples-of earth and-before all tribes-of your-people Israel;
sentences.i: And your glory will be lifted high like a cedar, and the light of your glory like the morning star, before all the peoples of the earth and all the tribes of your people Israel;
sentences.n: ይትሌዐል is the 3ms imperfect of the tä-stem of ለዐለ 'be high' (the jussive has the same form), so 'will be exalted' (?). ከመ here is 'like, as' and takes a noun: ከመ አርዝ 'like a cedar' (አርዝ is the cedar, collective), ወከመ ኮከበ ጽባሕ 'and like the morning star' (lit. 'star of dawn'; the verb is understood, and ብርሃነ ክብርከ 'light-of your-glory' is the subject, in the accusative as before). አሕዛበ ምድር and ነገደ ሕዝብከ are construct chains: 'peoples-of earth', 'tribes-of your-people'. The king is addressed as head of Israel, so the 'nations' are the others.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔርኒ ፡ ይሄሉ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍኖትከ ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ፈቃደከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘኀለይከ ።
sentences.l: For God-also he-will-be with-you in-all your-way, and-he-will-do your-will in-all what you-think.
sentences.i: For God also will be with you in all your way, and will do your will in all that you intend.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'. እግዚኣብሔርኒ carries the enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed'. ይሄሉ is ሀሎ 'be (present), exist', 3ms; ምስሌከ is ምስለ 'with' + -ከ. ዘኀለይከ is ዘ- + 2ms perfect of ኀለየ 'think, intend', so 'what you have in mind'. This closes the long sentence begun in 34. The thought of God doing the king's will is the reverse side of the king doing God's.

sentences.t: ወትወርስ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ፀርከ ፡ ወይትዌደስ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ግርማከ ፡ ወበብዝኀ ፡ ሰራዊትከ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-inherit cities-of your-enemy, and-it-will-be-praised greatness-of your-people through-abundance-of your-majesty and-through-abundance-of your-army;
sentences.i: You will inherit the cities of your enemy, and the greatness of your people will be praised, through the abundance of your majesty and of your army;
sentences.n: ትወርስ is ወረሰ 'inherit, take possession of'. ይትዌደስ is the tä-stem of ወድሰ 'praise', so 'be praised' (the long -ē- is as printed and I do not explain it; the sense 'be praised, magnified' is not in doubt); the grammatical subject ዕበየ ሕዝብከ stands in the accusative, again as if the verb were impersonal. ብዝኀ 'abundance' (from በዝኀ, see ያበዝኀከ) is in construct, with በ-: 'through the abundance of'. ግርማ is 'awe, majesty, terror' (all three shade into each other here); ሰራዊት is 'army'.

sentences.t: ወይፈርሁከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እለ ፡ ኢይገብሩ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ወትትለአክ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ይሁበከ ፡ ግርማ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሬእዩከ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-will-fear-you all who not-do his-will, God's, because you do his-will and-you-serve him, and-for-this he-will-give-you awe great before those who see-you;
sentences.i: All who do not do the will of God will fear you, because you do his will and serve him; and for this reason he will give you great awe before those who see you;
sentences.n: Echoes Deuteronomy 28:10, 'all the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of the Lord, and they shall be afraid of you'. ይፈርሁከ is ፈርሀ 'fear' with -ከ as the object, 3mp. ፈቃዶ ለእግዚኣብሔር is the same pronoun-then-owner construction as in unit 1. ትትለአክ is the tä-stem of ለአከ 'send', meaning 'serve, minister to' (with ሎቱ 'to him'). በእንተዝ is በእንተ + ዝ 'for this reason'. ዐቢየ is the accusative of ዐቢይ 'great' agreeing with ግርማ. ይሬእዩከ is 3mp of ርእየ 'see'.

sentences.t: በአልጒሞ ፡ አፍራሲከ ፡ ወበምጒንጳ ፡ ቀስትከ ፡ ወበአንጸብርቆ ፡ ወልታከ ፡ ይርዕድ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ወይሰግዱ ፡ ለከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስመ ፡ ይደነግፅ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ በርእየ ፡ ግርማከ ።
sentences.l: At-bridling-of your-horses and-at-(?)-of your-bow and-at-flash-of your-shield their-heart will-tremble, and-they-will-bow to-you to face-of earth, because it-will-be-struck-with-fear their-heart at-seeing-of your-majesty.
sentences.i: At the bridling of your horses, the (?) of your bow and the flashing of your shield, their hearts will tremble and they will bow to the ground before you, because their hearts will quake at the sight of your majesty.
sentences.n: Not a Deuteronomy passage, but the same idea as the verse just before: the nations' fear of the king. Lexical cruxes, no Dillmann to hand: አልጒሞ looks like a verbal noun of a verb 'to bridle' (from ልጓም 'bridle'), 'the bridling (of horses)' (?); ምጒንጳ is unclear, perhaps the drawing or twang of a bow (?); አንጸብርቆ is the noun of አንጸብረቀ 'flash, gleam'. Each takes በ- 'at'; the nouns in -o (አልጒሞ, አንጸብርቆ) are verbal nouns (infinitives) of their verbs. ልቦሙ is ልብ 'heart' + -ሙ 'their' (singular noun, so ይርዕድ and ይደነግፅ are 3ms: 'their heart trembles'). ይደነግፅ is ደንገፀ 'be startled, terrified'. በርእየ is the verbal noun of ርእየ, 'in seeing'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ይሬእዩከ ፡ እምርሑቅ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብሕርት ፡ ወቈላት ፡ ይወፅኡ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያግብኦሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘዐለዉ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-when they-see-you from-afar, those in mountains will-come-down to-land, and-those in seas and-lowlands will-come-out outside, so-that God may-hand-them into your-hand, because they-transgressed commandment-of God.
sentences.i: And when those in the mountains see you from afar, they will come down to the land, and those in the seas and lowlands will come out into the open, so that God may deliver them into your hand, because they have transgressed the commandment of God.
sentences.n: ሶበ is 'when'; ይሬእዩከ is 'they see you' and ይወርዱ is 'they go down' (ወረደ). The subject of the first verb is the people described by the following relative clauses (እለ 'those who' + ውስተ 'in'): mountain dwellers, and those in አብሕርት (plural of ባሕር 'sea'; 'lakes, wild country' also possible (?)) and ቈላት (ቈላ 'lowland, valley' (?)). ምድረ 'to the land' is an accusative of direction. ከመ ያግብኦሙ is 'so that he may deliver them' (አግብአ as in unit 18), with ውስተ እዴከ 'into your hand'. ዘዐለዉ is ዘ- + ዐለወ 'pass over, transgress', 3mp perfect: 'that they have gone beyond'; the object is ትእዛዘ እግዚኣብሔር, 'commandment-of God'.

sentences.t: ወአንተሰ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘሰአልከ ፡ ትነሥእ ፡ በኀቤሁ ፤ እስመ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አፍቀርኮ ፡ ያፈቅረከ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ዐቀብከ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ይሁበከ ፡ ስእለተ ፡ ልብከ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘኀሠሥከ ፡ ትነሥእ ፡ በኀቤሁ ።
sentences.l: And-as-for-you, when you-do his-will, everything that you-ask you-will-receive from-him; for if you-have-loved-him he-will-love-you, and-if you-have-kept his-commandment he-will-give-you request-of your-heart, and-everything that you-seek you-will-receive from-him.
sentences.i: As for you, when you do his will, whatever you ask you will receive from him; for if you love him he will love you, and if you keep his commandment he will give you the request of your heart, and everything you seek you will receive from him.
sentences.n: Compare Psalm 37:4 (36:4 in the Septuagint numbering), 'he will give you the requests of your heart', though this text does not quote it exactly. Conditional pairs: ሶበ ... 'when', ለእመ ... 'if' (perfect in the protasis: አፍቀርኮ 'you have loved him', ዐቀብከ 'you have kept', ዐቀብከ has the 2ms ending -ከ; አፍቀርኮ is the same ending plus -o 'him'; ያፈቅረከ is 'he will love you'). ዘሰአልከ and ዘኀሠሥከ are ዘ- + a 2ms perfect, 'what you asked / sought' (ሰአለ, ኀሠሠ). ትነሥእ በኀቤሁ is 'you will take from-with-him'. ስእለት is 'petition, request', and ስእለተ ልብከ is a construct chain.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኄር ፡ ለኄራን ፡ ወየዋህ ፡ ለየዋሃን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ፈቃዶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ፡ ወይሁቦሙ ፡ ዐስበ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይትዔገሥዎ ፤
sentences.l: For good to-the-good and-gentle to-the-gentle he, and-he-does their-will for-those who fear-him, and-he-gives-them reward to-those who wait-for-him;
sentences.i: For he is good to the good and gentle to the gentle, and he does the will of those who fear him and gives a reward to those who wait for him;
sentences.n: Compare Psalm 145:19 (144:19 in the Septuagint numbering), 'he fulfills the desire of those who fear him'. ኄር 'good', የዋህ 'gentle, guileless' (the Geʿez word has both a moral and a mild-tempered sense), with plurals ኄራን and የዋሃን after ለ- 'to'. ውእቱ 'he' closes the nominal clause. ይፈርህዎ is 3mp ፈርሀ + -ዎ 'him'; ይትዔገሥዎ is the imperfect of ተዐገሠ 'endure, wait patiently' (root ʿ-g-ś, the verb of ተዐገሳ in 44), here with 'him' as the object, so 'wait for him' (?). ይሁቦሙ is 'and he gives them' (ወ- + ይሁብ + -ሙ). ዐስብ is 'wage, reward'. The pronoun and ለእለ are the same pattern as before: ፈቃዶሙ 'their will' then the owners.

sentences.t: ተዐገሳ ፡ ለመዐት ፡ ወድኅረ ፡ ታስተፌሥሐከ ፡ ወአፍቅራ ፡ ለጽድቅ ፡ ወትፈሪ ፡ ለከ ፡ ሕይወት ፤
sentences.l: Bear-it, the-wrath, and-afterwards it-will-gladden-you; and-love-her, the-justice, and-you-will-bear for-you life;
sentences.i: Bear patiently with anger, and afterward it will gladden you; love justice, and you will bear life for yourself;
sentences.n: A turn from promises to commands, and the verbs are now imperatives (2ms). ተዐገሳ is ተዐገሠ 'endure, be patient' (spelled here with ሳ, not ሠ) + -ā 'her', anticipating the noun that follows, ለመዐት 'wrath' (feminine): 'endure it, the wrath'. This is the same pronoun-then-noun construction as ፈቃዶ ለእግዚኣብሔር. So also አፍቅራ ለጽድቅ 'love her, justice' (አፍቀረ). ወድኅረ 'and afterward'; ታስተፌሥሐከ is the causative አስተፈሥሐ with the 3fs prefix: 'she / it will make you glad', the feminine subject being whatever the -ā pointed to (the wrath, or the patience shown toward it; the sense is loose (?)). ትፈሪ is ፈረየ 'bear fruit', 2ms: 'you will bear life for yourself' (?); the same spelling could be 3fs, 'she will bear life for you'. The sense is a proverb-like pair, perhaps Proverbs 14:29, 'one slow to anger is great in understanding'; I name only the thought, not a quotation.

sentences.t: ኩንኄረ ፡ ለኄራን ፡ ወመገሥጸ ፡ ለመአብሳን ፡ ወአኅድጎ ፡ እኪተ ፡ ለእኩይ ፡ በገሥጾ ፡ ወበአርትዖ ፡ ወበአርስሖ ፡ ወበአኅስሮ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይዔምፅ ፡ ቢጾ ፡ በእኩይ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ ቅሥት ፤
sentences.l: Be good to-the-good and-a-rebuker for-the-wrongdoers, and-leave-it, evil to-the-evil-one, by-rebuking and-by-setting-straight and-by-(?) and-by-penalizing, for-the-one-who wrongs his-fellow with-evil in midst of court-of (?);
sentences.i: Be good to the good and a rebuker of wrongdoers, and put away evil from the evil man (?): by rebuking, by correcting, by (?) and by penalizing the one who wrongs his fellow with wickedness within the court of (?);
sentences.n: The most difficult unit of the chapter, and I give it with caution. ኩንኄረ is the imperative ኩን 'be' + ኄረ 'good' (accusative predicate); መገሥጸ is 'rebuker' (a noun from ገሥጸ 'rebuke'); ለመአብሳን is from a word I cannot pin down, perhaps አበሰ 'sin'; 'wrongdoers' by the context (?). አኅድጎ is አኅደገ 'leave, forgive' + -o 'it', and again the pronoun anticipates the noun (እኪተ 'evil'); how it relates to ለእኩይ ('for/to the evil man') is a crux, and I have taken it as 'put away evil from the evil man' (?). The four infinitive phrases, each with በ- 'by': ገሥጾ 'rebuking', አርትዖ 'setting straight' (አርትዐ), አርስሖ (?) and አኅስሮ 'penalizing, fining' (አኅሰረ); the final -o is the ending of the infinitive, though it could also be 'him' (?). I cannot parse አርስሖ with confidence. The relative ለዘ ይዔምፅ ቢጾ is 'for the one who wrongs his fellow' (ዐመፀ 'act unjustly'); ዐውደ ቅሥት, 'the circle / court of ...', I read as the court of judgment but ቅሥት is uncertain (?).

sentences.t: ወፍታሕ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ ወለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ፡ ወአንግፎ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ዘይዔምፆ ፤
sentences.l: And-judge for-the-poor and-for-the-orphan, and-rescue-him from-hand-of him-who wrongs-him;
sentences.i: Give judgment for the poor man and for the orphan, and rescue him from the hand of the one who wrongs him;
sentences.n: Compare Psalm 82:3-4 (81:3-4 in the Septuagint numbering): 'give justice to the weak and the orphan... deliver him from the hand of the wicked', and Isaiah 1:17. ፍታሕ is the imperative of ፈትሐ 'judge' (see ይፈትሕ in 26); the poor are ነዳይ. እጓለ ማውታ is 'offspring of the dead', i.e. an orphan; ወለ- is for ወ- 'and' + ለ-. አንግፎ is the imperative አንግፍ 'snatch away, rescue' + -o 'him'; እምእደ ዘይዔምፆ is እም 'from' + እድ 'hand' (construct) + ዘ- 'the one who' + ይዔምፅ + -o 'him'.

sentences.t: ወአድኅን ፡ ባሕታዌ ፡ ወጽኑሰ ፡ ወአንግፎ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ዘይትዔገሎ ።
sentences.l: And-save the-solitary and-the-sick, and-rescue-him from-hand-of him-who oppresses-him.
sentences.i: Save the solitary and the sick, and rescue him from the hand of the one who oppresses him.
sentences.n: Imperatives again, አድኅን 'save' and አንግፎ 'rescue him'. ባሕታዌ is 'one alone, solitary' (ባሕታዊ), here with the sense of the friendless (?); ወጽኑሰ is ወ- + ጽኑስ 'sick, ill' (ጽኑስ with the accusative -ä after the imperative gives ጽኑሰ; the -ሰ is not the contrastive enclitic). ዘይትዔገሎ is the relative + a tä-stem verb, 'who oppresses him' (the verb is not securely known to me (?)).

sentences.t: ወኢትፍታሕ ፡ በአድልዎ ፡ ወበነሢአ ፡ ገጽ ፡ አላ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ፍታሕ ፤ ወኢታፍቅር ፡ ሕልያነ ፡ በነሢአ ፡ ፍትሕ ፡ በአድልዎ ፡ ለገጽ ፤ ወለመኳንንቲከኒ ፡ ገሥጾሙ ፡ ከመይኩኑ ፡ ንጹሓነ ፡ እምሕልያን ፡ ወኢያድልዉ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ለገጸ ፡ ፍቁራኒሆሙ ፡ ወኢለጸላኢሆሙ ፤ ወኢለአብዕልቲሆሙ ፡ ወኢለነዳያኒሆሙ ፤ አላ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ይኴንኑ ፡ ቢጾሙ ፡ በርቱዕ ፡ ፍትሕ ፨
sentences.l: And-do-not-judge with-partiality and-with-taking-of face, but in-justice judge; and-do-not-love bribes by-taking judgment in-partiality for-face; and-your-officials-also, rebuke-them, that-they-be pure from-bribes and-not bend judgment for-face-of their-beloved and-not for-their-enemies, and-not for-their-rich and-not for-their-poor; but in-justice judgment let-them-judge their-fellows in-right judgment.
sentences.i: Do not judge with partiality or by taking account of the face, but judge in justice. Do not love bribes, in taking up a judgment out of partiality for a person. And as for your officials, rebuke them, so that they stay clean of bribes and do not bend judgment toward the person of their loved ones or their enemies, their rich or their poor; but let them judge their fellows with justice and with right judgment.
sentences.n: The closing counsel on the courts, in the spirit of Leviticus 19:15 and Deuteronomy 16:19 ('you shall not pervert justice; you shall not show partiality'). ነሢአ ገጽ is 'taking face', the idiom for partiality; ኢትፍታሕ and ኢታፍቅር are negative commands (2ms), against the positive ፍታሕ. ሕልያነ is the accusative of ሕልያን 'bribes' (?). The run-together ከመይኩኑ is ከመ ይኩኑ 'that they be'. ወለመኳንንቲከኒ is ወ- + ለ- + መኳንንት (plural of መኰንን 'official, governor') + -ከ + the enclitic -ኒ 'also'; ገሥጾሙ is the imperative ገሥጽ + -ሙ 'them'. ኢያድልዉ is አድለወ 'show partiality' (3mp, negated); the object ፍትሐ is accusative 'judgment'. ፍቁራኒሆሙ 'their beloved', ጸላኢሆሙ 'their enemies', አብዕልቲሆሙ 'their rich', ነዳያኒሆሙ 'their poor' all take the possessive -ሆሙ 'their' (ጸላኢ is singular, used collectively: 'their enemy'). The last clause is ኵነኔ ... ይኴንኑ 'let them judge a judgment', ቢጾሙ 'their fellows'; ፍትሕ ends the chapter with ፨.
